scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved by finite normalization and complete sign-inversion analysis; literature priority remains provisional pending external verification.
scientific_limitations: Only complex affine three-variable circuits with positive pairwise coprime exponents; the complete local types at multiple-curve intersections and special-phase image singularities are not classified. The checker is a finite consistency test, not the general proof.
title: Exact generic singular-curve census and phase-dependent normalization of three-variable Lissajous hypersurfaces
